children: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd reported 2026 quarterly results with revenue of $479M and diluted EPS of $0.67, driven by higher product volume and improved price mix versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher product volume and improvements in price mix.
Sales mix shifted toward direct-to-consumer and e-commerce, offsetting slower wholesale demand.
New marketing campaigns and product launches supported brand momentum and customer retention.
Operationally, the company expanded production capacity and implemented automation to reduce lead times and improve margins.
Management expects continued revenue growth with targeted cost controls and further investment in digital channels.
